item.tib: 'chi med rigs 'dzin byin brlabs gnas chen rgya nag glang po ri yi dkar chag sangs rgyas gling gis mdzad pa
item.coloph: ces gnas chen po rgya nag glang po ri la snyigs dus kyi 'gro kun sdug bsngal nyams thag pa'i dus/ 'gro kun bcing bkrol zhing dbug phyung la 'dod pa'i khul du 'chi med lha yi lung bzhin/ rab brtan ces pa'i lcags phag gi zla ba gsum pa'i tshes la lam gyi dka' ba mang po bsring zhing gnas chen ri la phyin pa'i/ ri'i rtse mo la 'o yun rngan zhes sprin 'bar lha khang du/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i bdud rtsi myong grol bsgrubs pa dang mchod pa brgya rtsa grub pa'i bkra shis dga' ston brgya'i dus su/ skyes mchog rgyal khyung dge bshes nang so blo ldan snying po'i ma 'ongs skal ldan gyi bu rnams kun/ rgya bod khyad ma mchis kyang rang re bod kyi sa thags (thag) ring po nas/ gnas 'di la mos shing mjal du yong ba rnams/ rtsa ru phyin tshe gnas kyi lo rgyus mdo yi lugs su nyung tsam 'dug rung*/ rgya hu shang gi skad du song ba'i nges shes rnyed pa'i lo rgyas mi rnyed cing / dper na khang mdzod tha ram 'gag pa/ lta bur snang ba tsam ma zad pa'i bdag sogs mos pa'i grwa slobs (slob) dang phyi rabs nges shes rnyed pa'i don la dgongs pa'i gnas kyi lo rgyus dang bzhugs rabs yon tan bka' chabs (chab) gsal po cig btabs (gdab) dgongs gsungs nas/ nan tan byung ba phyir mi ldog phyir du/ slar chu bya'i lo zla tshes la bstan pa'i yon bdag mdo gling rgyal sa phyin dus g.yung drung gling du thun 'tshams (mtshams) la/ gnas kyi bka' chab (chab) zur rtsam (tsam) mkha' spyod pa byang chub snying po bde ba'i rdo rje'i (rjes) bris pa'o//
